description: Fig. 12 is a single hand-drawn-style sketch: a Taylor-factor M distribution map drawn on a standard inverse-pole-figure triangle for the TA direction, with a curved right-hand edge. Its three corners are labelled 001 (bottom left) carrying the printed value 2.30, 111 (top apex) with 3.64, and 101 (bottom right) with 3.64. Two thick black arrows, each labelled "M", run along the 001→111 edge (pointing up-right) and along the 001→101 edge (pointing right), marking the direction of increasing Taylor factor away from the 001 corner. A dashed boundary line divides the triangle into a lower-left region annotated "M < 2.7" and an upper/right region annotated "M > 3.06". The word "Twins" is written twice inside the triangle — once in the low-M region immediately adjacent to the dashed boundary and once inside the M > 3.06 region. The figure makes a single argument: orientation regions with a high Taylor factor (towards 111 and 101) correspond to the "Twins" domains where deformation twinning is activated, matching the citing text for type II and III grains. No axes, scale bar or further numeric values are printed.

observations.observation: The figure is a single schematic triangular map (inverse-pole-figure standard triangle with a curved right edge), not a data plot: no axes with units, no scale bar and no error bars are present.
The three triangle corners are labelled 001 (bottom left), 111 (top apex) and 101 (bottom right), with printed numbers 2.30 at 001 and 3.64 at both 111 and 101.
Two thick black arrows both labelled 'M' run along the 001→111 edge and along the 001→101 edge, indicating the direction of increasing Taylor factor starting from the 001 corner.
A dashed line inside the triangle separates a lower-left region annotated 'M < 2.7' from an upper/right region annotated 'M > 3.06'.
The label 'Twins' appears twice within the triangle: once in the low-Taylor-factor region next to the dashed boundary and once inside the M > 3.06 region.
The caption states this is a sketch of the Taylor factor M distribution along the TA direction in this steel; the sketch itself is not annotated with the TA direction string.

The citing text states that twinning is primarily activated in high Taylor factor grains (type II and III), which is the interpretation supported by the 'Twins' labels placed in the high-M region of this sketch.

The citing text reports experimental critical twinning stresses of about 723 MPa at RT and about 778 MPa at LNT, compared with Taylor-model values of 1306 MPa (RT) and 934 MPa (LNT); these numbers are stated in the text and do not appear in this figure.

subfigures.description: A schematic Taylor-factor map drawn as an inverse-pole-figure triangle with corners 001 (2.30), 111 (3.64) and 101 (3.64); two arrows labelled 'M' indicate increasing Taylor factor from the 001 corner; a dashed line separates a 'M < 2.7' region from an 'M > 3.06' region, and 'Twins' is written in both regions.
